user.description: Enter the IP address and port of your OverSight Android TV device.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Android TV device running OverSight.
data_description.port: Port of the OverSight API, shown in the app's settings (default 5001).

zeroconf_confirm.description: Found OverSight device: **{name}**. Do you want to add it?

error.connection: Unable to connect to the device.
error.missing_device_id: The device did not report a device ID. Make sure the OverSight app has finished starting, then try again.

abort.already_in_progress: Setup of this device is already in progress.
abort.connection: Unable to connect to the discovered device.
abort.missing_device_id: The discovered device did not report a device ID.

send_notification.name: Send notification
send_notification.description: Shows a popup notification on the device, with optional icons, image, video and placement.

id.name: ID
id.description: Sending a notification with the same ID and source as the one on screen replaces it instead of queueing a new one.

image.name: Image
image.description: URL of an image to display.

video.name: Video
video.description: URL of a video to play: RTSP, HLS, MP4 and other common formats.

small_icon.name: Small icon
small_icon.description: MDI icon name, for example "mdi:bell". Shown as a dark circle badge: on its own if there is no large icon, otherwise at the top right of the large icon.

small_icon_color.name: Small icon color
small_icon_color.description: Tint color for the small icon. Quote hex values in YAML, for example "#FF5733".

large_icon.name: Large icon
large_icon.description: MDI icon name or image URL for the main icon.

corner.name: Corner
corner.description: Corner to show this notification in, overriding the hot corner setting.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to show the notification, overriding the notification duration setting.

layout.name: Layout
layout.description: A complete layout object to use for this notification only. See the OverSight app documentation for the layout fields.

send_fixed_notification.name: Send fixed notification
send_fixed_notification.description: Creates or updates a fixed notification badge on the device. When updating, fields you leave out keep their current values.

id.name: ID
id.description: Identifier of the badge. Use the same ID to update an existing badge.

visible.name: Visible
visible.description: Show or hide the badge without removing it.

icon.name: Icon
icon.description: MDI icon name, for example "mdi:weather-sunny", or an image URL.

text.name: Text
text.description: Text to display on the badge.

icon_color.name: Icon color
icon_color.description: Color for the icon. Quote hex values in YAML, for example "#FF5722".

message_color.name: Text color
message_color.description: Color for the badge text. Quote hex values in YAML, for example "#FFFFFF".

background_color.name: Background color
background_color.description: Background color for the badge, optionally with alpha. Quote hex values in YAML, for example "#CC333333".

border_color.name: Border color
border_color.description: Border color for the badge. Quote hex values in YAML, for example "#FFD700".

expiration.name: Expiration
expiration.description: When the badge is removed. Either a duration such as "30m", "2h" or "1d12h" (units y, w, d, h, m, s), a number of seconds, or a Unix timestamp in seconds or milliseconds.

show_duration.name: Show duration
show_duration.description: Seconds to show the text before collapsing to the icon only.

collapse_duration.name: Collapse duration
collapse_duration.description: Seconds to stay collapsed before expanding again. Needs repeat expand.

repeat_expand.name: Repeat expand
repeat_expand.description: Keep cycling between expanded and collapsed.

remove_fixed_notification.name: Remove fixed notification
remove_fixed_notification.description: Removes a fixed notification badge from the device.

id.name: ID
id.description: The ID of the badge to remove.

set_clock_appearance.name: Set clock appearance
set_clock_appearance.description: Changes how the clock overlay looks. Fields you leave out keep their current values.

color.name: Color
color.description: Clock text color. Quote hex values in YAML, for example "#FFFFFF".

display_shadow.name: Display shadow
display_shadow.description: Draw a shadow behind the clock text.

background_color.name: Background color
background_color.description: Clock background color, optionally with alpha. Quote hex values in YAML, for example "#80000000".
